C0555.title: Man Sentenced for 2,700+ Fraudulent Refund-Only Claims via Malicious Ordering
keywords: crime of disrupting production and business operations
C0555.summary: On December 30, 2025, after prosecution by the Jiangyin People's Procuratorate, the court issued a first-instance judgment in Chen's malicious-ordering profit scheme. Since 2022, Chen had used refund-only claims, complaints, and repeated ordering and refunding against related stores to pressure merchants, placing more than 2,700 malicious orders against over 900 online stores, causing more than 62,000 yuan in transaction-fee losses and forcing six merchants to pay 6,400 yuan in settlement fees. The court convicted him of disrupting production and business operations and sentenced him to one year and six months in prison.
